memory_updates.future_rule: Apply a world-first portfolio pass with component risks and asymmetric paths; no correlation/overlap veto or mandatory hedge. Judge old and new exposures from current forward risk.
memory_updates.text: Portfolio method reinforced on2026-11-05: Start with world changes and the opportunity set, then decompose each candidate and current position into growth, inflation, policy, energy/terms of trade, fiscal/term premium, currency, liquidity, financing, horizon and path risks as relevant. Evaluate joint state-dependent and asymmetric payoffs at proposed sizes. Negative correlation does not require a hedge; positive correlation is not automatically duplication. Shared factors can coexist with distinct pricing, timing, catalysts and realization paths. Neither a correlation sign nor an imperfect coefficient proves diversification or edge. One position, several or flat are all legitimate after a genuine comparison. Kevin's AUDNZD/CORRA illustration is methodological coaching, not a trade instruction.

memory_updates.future_rule: 2026-11-05 coaching/process lesson, not a proven edge: Requiring price confirmation or statistical proof before entry can consume the opportunity. Compare exposure now, one explicit wait condition and rejection using the same starting evidence and price. State what waiting buys, what worse entry/foregone move it can cause and when waiting loses. Lower conviction can justify smaller initial exposure; subsequent confirmation may justify adding rather than being an entry prerequisite. Unknowns should usually change size, horizon or management; explain any specific uncertainty that prevents risk-taking. This is not a forced-trading rule.

memory_updates.future_rule: 2026-11-05 process lesson: Do not grandfather an owned position because it made money, its entry is favorable or its old invalidation has not printed while demanding much stronger proof from a new idea. Ask what would be initiated from flat at current forward risk and size. A narrower forward edge can justify reducing even when the original thesis remains directionally valid. Harvest as remaining edge closes, consider time exits for failed repricing, and reassess residuals rather than holding indefinitely for the original target.

memory_updates.future_rule: 2026-11-05 process lesson: Every serious proposal, including HOLD, needs a judgment-supported target range, intended repricing horizon, normal-movement yardstick, fundamental falsifier, practical exit/review, initial exposure, target payoff, planned-exit loss, worse gap/stress and same-horizon financing assumptions. Establish a dollar loss budget and derive size from credible adverse movement and portfolio context, not unused capacity. Distinguish an eventual policy outcome from a weeks/months trading target. A volatility band is not a target or a probability; a favorable reward/stop ratio is not expected value. Stops can be hit by ordinary noise and do not guarantee a loss cap.

memory_updates.future_rule: 2026-11-05 bounded empirical finding and process lesson: In the authorized roughly six-month five-pair test, typical contemporaneous rate-spread-change/spot-return links were weak and differential levels did not reliably predict the next aligned move. USD/CAD showed an approximately0.51 next-aligned-return correlation with positive holdout sign; that exception is not causality or a trading rule and does not justify a universal zero-correlation claim. Distinguish levels, changes, contemporaneous association, prediction and actual carry. G10 carry is a cost/benefit, not a gravitational fair-value rule; materiality depends on size and horizon. EM comparisons were not tested. Missing forward points limit precision: use clearly labeled cost sensitivities where defensible, not a blanket G10 spot ban.

memory_updates.future_rule: 2026-11-05 process lesson: A0.79% EUR rally already being in the close does not establish that a political/energy adjustment is complete. Historical percentiles and lack of a precisely estimated residual do not by themselves establish negative expected return. A broad-dollar thesis can be expressed through EURUSD without requiring euro-specific outperformance or alpha versus every European peer. Conversely, an attractive narrative or extreme level alone does not prove a trade. Own the causal interpretation and explain continuation, exhaustion and opposing paths. Oil can improve importer demand, hurt producer income and support global risk simultaneously; do not impose one fixed FX oil beta.

memory_updates.future_rule: 2026-11-05 evidence lesson: Preserve freeze, generation, source-observation and actual authorship/persistence clocks. An earlier close newly read today is not post-forecast performance. Keep original forecasts and rejected alternatives rather than rewriting them with hindsight; record entry-now versus wait plans prospectively. A stored n252 does not supply252 history rows when only126 are embedded. Percentile fields on a0–100 scale must not be multiplied by100: CAD/NOK0.03968 was about the0.04th percentile, not4th. Historical ranks depend on window and regime. Do not combine asynchronous nominal/real/breakeven observations into a precise same-day decomposition, or use expired/spliced-contract artifacts as clean oil history.

New positions need genuine judgment, not compliance with Kevin's illustrative trade examples or pressure to increase position count.

Discuss scope before every analysis launch; no automatic extra run/followup/retry. Frozen common evidence plus Kevin input is the information boundary; repairs/newer main are not private new market evidence. Concurrent work uses unique isolated branches and disjoint write paths, with no merges or production edits by research jobs. Issue creation is submission, not launch or successful memory/trade persistence; verify authoritative receipts and actual artifacts.
